_comment: Ceilings and the allowlist for the three ratchet gates. A ceiling only ever
moves DOWN, to the measured count, once the drop is deliberate. A ceiling
that has to rise is a flag-and-proceed with the new number and the reason
forbiddenPatternAllowlist is APPEND-FORBIDDEN. Entries may only be removed
or lowered, and the gate enforces the lowering half itself: an entry that
allows more than is measured fails as STALE, so the ratchet cannot go slack
